text:
matt: Heads up — seeing ~2.5ms median tokenization bump on streaming gRPC after the kernel-affinity canary. KV-hit flows look fine but cold-paths spike. Anyone else seeing this? cc @alex @sam

alex: Yup, noticed a tail on the perf dashboard. Correlates with the affinity change that sometimes routes small runs to the scalar fallback. @lisa did you tweak batching hints recently?

lisa: I adjusted heuristics to favor low latency for small sequences. Didn't expect host-side parse/tokenize to be the dominant cost. Can someone drop a flame/pprof?

matt: Quick pprof snapshot from edge-host (rough):```text
ticks: 1000
  40% token::tokenize_single
  25% grpc::read_frame
  15% parser::http2_inbound
  10% kvcache::lookup
  10% others
```tokenization is up on canary hosts.

sam: Are KV miss rates higher on those traces? On miss we do extra alloc/copy which can amplify tokenization cost.

infra-bot: canary-deploy: kernel-affinity-v2 rolled to 10% (hostpool-3) at 2025-06-14T09:12:01Z :rocket:

alex: From a trace: many requests are 1-3 small tokens -> batching heuristic chooses mini-batch path which triggers a kernel that expects batched tensors; shim does extra flatten/copy. The kernel swap likely added a memcpy on the host side.

matt: Repro command I used:```bash
./tools/repro -q 1000 -seq 32 -grpc-stream
```that shows the spike on canary.

lisa: Mitigation options: revert affinity for small runs or change preparse to do in-place tokenization for streaming. Which is lower risk?

sam: :thumbsup: Prefer preparse in-place change first — less kernel churn. We should bench both.

matt: I'll run an A/B on the canary pool. Also adding quick metrics: `host.tokenization.ms` and `host.kernel.swap.count`. Check kvcache warmup/TTL while we're at it.

alex: I'll add a synthetic trace to perf-tests and instrument the mini-batch path for extra memcpy counts. If host tokenization can't be reduced we should bias batching heuristics away from the flattening kernel.

lisa: I'll open a PR with an in-place tokenization for the streaming path + a flag to toggle kernel affinity. ETA EOD.

matt: Nice. Tagging this thread with #perf-regression #ingress. Post A/B results here — thanks everyone.
